Planning Your Scheduling App

Before you start building your scheduling app, it's essential to plan its features and functionality. Consider the following:

  • What type of appointments will you be scheduling (e.g., in-person meetings, phone calls, video conferences)?
  • What are the working hours and availability of your mortgage brokers?
  • How will you handle scheduling conflicts and no-shows?
  • What kind of notifications and reminders will you need to send to clients and brokers?
